html:
The Iași Chișinău offensive was a Soviet attack in August 1944 that encircled and destroyed the German and Romanian armies holding Bessarabia and northeast Romania.

Two Soviet fronts struck on 20 August and closed the ring within days. Germany lost most of its Sixth Army for the second time after Stalingrad. On 23 August King Michael's coup in Bucharest took Romania out of the Axis, opening the Balkans to the Red Army. The offensive put Bessarabia back under the Soviet Union for good, and made Chișinău the capital of the Moldavian republic again. Much of the city lay in ruins.
sum: The Iași Chișinău offensive was a Soviet attack in August 1944 that encircled and destroyed the German and Romanian armies holding Bessarabia and northeast Romania.
